verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships its own AI product, Visalaw AI, which has a Research Agent and workflow automation, so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence mentions MCP, connecting external tool servers, or any extensibility mechanism. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
